references.text: Describes the same skills given to Bezalel: work with stone, wood, and all kinds of craftsmanship.
The immediate context describing God's Spirit filling Bezalel with wisdom and knowledge for artistic work.
Hiram from Tyre was also filled with wisdom and understanding to perform all kinds of work in bronze, similar craft skills.
Huram-Abi had skills in working with stone, wood, and other materials for the temple construction.
Instructions about precious stones to be set in place, related to the stonework mentioned in the verse.
Complementary description of the same divine gift that expands the skill profile from metal/stone/wood to textiles.
Direct part of the same list of skills confirming the breadth of Bezalel's divine gift.
Theological parallel showing that the same type of divine craft wisdom is given to both Bezalel and Hiram for building God's house.
